links.outcome: Note-level recall of PII removal by fine-tuned LLM deidentification against double-annotated reference
links.effect: Mistral 7B note-level recall 0.9326 (Llama 2 0.6888, Mixtral 8x7B 0.6417); 0.9915 for names only; 4 of 3000 notes retained a name.
links.quote: At the clinical notes level, the model's overall recall was 0.9326 (vs 0.6888 for Llama 2 and 0.6417 for Mixtral 8×7B).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning moderate-sized open-source LLMs for on-premises deidentification of clinical notes on personal computers

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks fine-tuned moderate-sized open-source LLMs (Mistral 7B, Llama 2 7B, Mixtral 8x7B) for clinical de-identification on emergency department notes. Although framed around hospital feasibility and data privacy/security requirements, it evaluates model performance and text preservation metrics rather than comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
